## Description

Describe the problem and the expected behavior.

## Reproduction

Provide the smallest reproducible example, including versions and environment.

## Developer Preview impact

Identify whether this affects Agent Identity, Capability Discovery, Task
Exchange, Execution, Verification, or Settlement Evidence.

## Security

Do not include credentials, tokens, private keys, private infrastructure, or
sensitive evidence. Report vulnerabilities through the process in SECURITY.md.
